title: A-S 380 - Black and White Darkroom Photography
description: A-S 380 is an introductory course in photography. Although it provides a thorough background in basic techniques that students may apply to any discipline, its primary emphasis is upon the practice of the medium as a fine art. Students receive technical instruction in camera and lens construction, exposure controls, processing of black and white negatives and prints, and presentation. Studio, nine hours per week.
attributes: Meets UK Core Intellectual Inquiry in Arts and Creativity
